The airplane shall be assumed to subjected to symmetrical

maneuvers resulting in the following limit load factors, except where limited by maximum (static) lift coefficients: (a) The positive maneuvering load factor specified in § 3.186 at all speeds up to Vd, (b) The negative maneuvering load factor specified in § 3.188 at speed Vc; and factors varying linearly with speed from the specified value at Vc to 0.0 at Vd for the N category and - 1.0 at Vd for the A and U categories. § 3.186 Maneuvering load factors.
